free_text: The patient is a 67-year-old male with a PSA of 6.9 and a biopsy-confirmed ISUP grade group 2 prostate cancer. MRI shows a focal lesion in the right peripheral zone with restricted diffusion and early enhancement, without extracapsular extension. The management assessment is to review individual treatment benefit and preferences. The trade-off involves balancing the risk of progression against the potential benefits of treatment given the localized, low-grade nature of the disease.
